Rcon.CommandPlaceholder: Type an RCON command (e.g., help, players, servermsg Hello)
Rcon.TroubleshootingTitle: Connection Issues? Troubleshooting Guide (Docker / Podman / Windows / Linux)
Rcon.TroubleshootingBasicText: Ensure your servertest.ini file has a port (e.g., RCONPort=27015) and a password (e.g., RCONPassword=your_pass) configured. The server must be restarted after changes.
Rcon.TroubleshootingNative: If using native app (Linux or Windows without container)
Rcon.TroubleshootingNativeText1: Use IP 127.0.0.1 if the PZ server is on the same machine.
Rcon.TroubleshootingNativeText2: If the PZ server is on another network, use its public or local IP and ensure the port is open in your router/firewall.
Rcon.TroubleshootingDocker: If using Docker or Podman on Windows (Most common issue)
Rcon.TroubleshootingDockerText1: Project Zomboid server typically restricts RCON connections to localhost. When running this app from a container, connections come from a virtual network, causing timeouts or connection refused errors.
Rcon.TroubleshootingSol1Text: Use your machine's Local IPv4 IP instead of 127.0.0.1 or host.containers.internal.
